name: Workspaces with window icons
author: Sebastix
description: Workspace number indicators that also show the icon of each running window / application on that workspace which are clickable to switch

barWidget.description: Workspace number indicators with running window icons

schema.label: Workspace number size offset
schema.description: Shifts the workspace number away from the bar's font size. 0 matches the rest of the bar; negative values shrink it.

schema.label: Window icon size offset
schema.description: Shifts the window icons away from their default size, which follows the bar's font size. 0 keeps the default; negative values shrink them. Icons never grow past the bar's height.
